label_definition: 1 if max high over the next 95 sessions (global calendar) >= 1.5x entry close; NaN if the window passes the panel end
walk_forward: test year Y scored by models trained on labelled rows whose label window ends before Y's first session; window = sessions t+1..t+95 of the global calendar (session-counted labels, verified on the panel)

metric_notes.wk_auc: mean over weeks of within-week AUC (labelled rows, full mcap>=50cr universe)
metric_notes.wk_top1: mean over weeks of precision in the top max(1, n//100) rows by score; lift = mean precision / mean base
metric_notes.close: weekly top-10 among tradable rows (ADV>=5cr, raw close>50), entry at signal close, hit = y95; hit over labelled picks, hit_lo/hit_hi treat unlabelled picks as miss/hit
metric_notes.next_open: same, entry at the next REAL session's open (copied sessions skipped), UC-locked/not-trading names skipped, hit = fh95*close_t/open_t+1 >= 1.5
metric_notes.hit_ex_copied_session: same picks, hit rate without picks dated on a copied (non-trading) session
metric_notes.hit_ex_long_span: same picks, hit rate without picks whose 95-row window spans >= 105 sessions (row-counted labels: inflated; session-counted: lower bounds); long_span_picks = their count
